name: opening_gap_reversal
formula: let p=close[T-1]; g=(O0-p)/p; u=max(0,O0-min(L0,L1))/(g*p+1e-8) if g>0.002 else 0; d=max(0,max(H0,H1)-O0)/(-g*p+1e-8) if g<-0.002 else 0; r=u-d
signal_direction: Negative; high=fade gap up; low=fade gap down
rationale: Institutional absorption at open; mean-revert to VWAP by 14:30

name: spike_exhaustion_ratio
signal_direction: Negative when positive; high=unsustainable spike
rationale: Aggressive open without follow-through leaves supply/demand vacuum
limitation: Sensitive to outliers; fails in genuine trend starts

name: barbed_wire_intensity
formula: seq=longest >=3 bars where H_i<=H_{i-1}+eps and L_i>=L_{i-1}-eps; doji=sum(abs(O-C)<0.2*(H-L+1e-8) for b in seq); tail=mean((H-max(O,C)+min(O,C)-L)/(H-L+1e-8) for b in seq); r=len(seq)*doji*tail/(D+1)
signal_direction: Negative; high=equilibrium; low-volatility drift
rationale: Overlapping bars + long tails + small bodies = indecision; range stays tight

name: wedge_open_flag
formula: ph=i where H_i>H_{i-1} and H_i>H_{i+1}; pl=i where L_i<L_{i-1} and L_i<L_{i+1}; r=-1 if 3 ph descending else +1 if 3 pl ascending else 0
signal_direction: Positive; detected wedge flag predicts trend resumption
rationale: Three-push wedges = mechanical pullback; fade gets stopped out; afternoon acceleration

name: inside_bar_compression
formula: inside=bars where H_i<=H_{i-1} and L_i>=L_{i-1}; r=1-mean(H-L for i in inside)/mean(H-L for all)
signal_direction: Volatility conditioner; high compression = larger afternoon range
rationale: Inside bars = coiling; coil break sweeps opening-range extremes before settling
limitation: Directional sign needs interaction with breakout direction

name: volume_climax_exhaustion
input_data: OHLCV bars[0..D]; Index daily volume T-1
signal_direction: Negative; high=volume climax + reversal = mean-revert
rationale: One-sided flow exhausts quickly; equilibrium creates session-wide range

name: twenty_gap_bars_regime
formula: e=ema(close_daily,20,T-252..T-1); bull=count consecutive close>e ending T-1; bear=count consecutive close<e ending T-1; r=(bull-bear)/20 clip [-1,1]
signal_direction: Positive; long streak = dip-buying floor; short streak = fade
rationale: Prolonged separation builds institutional trend-following adds; floor persists intraday
limitation: Slow-changing; near-zero variance flat markets; >=60 days history

name: measured_move_proximity
formula: H=last swing high (2-bar pivot) before T-2; L=last swing low before T-2; if last leg up: tgt=H+(H-L) else tgt=L-(L-H); r=clip((close[T-1]-tgt)/atr_daily(14),-2,2)
signal_direction: Negative when r>1 overshoot; positive when r<-1 undershoot
rationale: Algorithmic profit-taking at measured targets; trend pauses/pullbacks spill into next day
limitation: Swing detection noisy; needs clear recent leg

name: first_bar_sentiment
signal_direction: Contextual; positive = bullish open bias; negative = bearish
rationale: First bar captures overnight sentiment and initial auction imbalance

name: opening_range_size
signal_direction: Positive; larger range = higher uncertainty/volatility regime
rationale: Opening range reflects overnight information absorption and liquidity provision
limitation: Wide in high-vol events; narrow in low-vol

name: or_fill_ratio
signal_direction: Contextual; near 1 = strong bullish; near 0 = strong bearish
rationale: Where price closes relative to opening auction range indicates conviction
limitation: Depends on range width; narrow ranges meaningless

name: intraday_bullish_fvg
signal_direction: Positive; larger gap = stronger supply-demand imbalance
rationale: Unfilled bullish gap = institutional demand exceeded supply; price tends to retest/retrace
limitation: Requires >=3 bars; gaps may fill intraday

name: intraday_bearish_fvg
signal_direction: Negative; larger gap = stronger bearish imbalance
rationale: Unfilled bearish gap = institutional supply excess; price tends to retest upside
limitation: Requires >=3 bars; gaps may fill intraday

name: inside_bar_failure_bull
formula: r=sum(1 for i in [0..D-2] where H_i<=H_{i-1} and L_i>=L_{i-1} and H_{i+1}>H_i and C_{i+1}>L_i)
signal_direction: Positive; count of failed inside bars to upside
rationale: Inside bar = balance; failure to upside signals absorption of selling; continuation up
limitation: Low-frequency; choppy markets produce many false failures

name: inside_bar_failure_bear
formula: r=sum(1 for i in [0..D-2] where H_i<=H_{i-1} and L_i>=L_{i-1} and L_{i+1}<L_i and C_{i+1}<H_i)
signal_direction: Negative; count of failed inside bars to downside
rationale: Failure breakdown signals absorption of buying; continuation down
limitation: Low-frequency; choppy markets produce many false failures

name: early_bullish_hammer
formula: body=abs(C-O); lower=min(O,C)-L; upper=H-max(O,C); r=max(lower/(body+1e-8) for i in [0..D] if lower>2*body and upper<body and C>O)
signal_direction: Positive; hammer = buying rejection at lows; afternoon bounce
rationale: Long lower shadow shows limit bids absorbing selling pressure near session low
limitation: Requires significant range; weak in strong downtrends

name: early_bearish_shooting_star
concept: Bearish shooting star in opening bars
formula: body=abs(C-O); upper=H-max(O,C); lower=min(O,C)-L; r=max(upper/(body+1e-8) for i in [0..D] if upper>2*body and lower<body and C<O)
signal_direction: Negative; star = selling rejection at highs; afternoon fade
rationale: Long upper shadow shows limit offers absorbing buying pressure near session high
limitation: Requires significant range; weak in strong uptrends

name: early_doji_count
formula: r=sum(1 for i in [0..D] if abs(C-O)<0.1*(H-L+1e-8))
signal_direction: Negative; more dojis = indecision; narrow range drift
rationale: Doji bars reflect equilibrium; high doji count = no net commitment; mean-reversion
normalization: Already count; divide by (D+1) for ratio

name: consecutive_up_closes
formula: up=0; r=max(up_i where up_i=(C_i>C_{i-1})?nz(up_{i-1})+1:0 for i in [0..D]) with up0=1
signal_direction: Positive; long streak = momentum continuation into afternoon
rationale: Consecutive up closes indicate sustained buying pressure; trend-following algos add longs
limitation: Weak standalone; needs trend regime filter

name: consecutive_down_closes
formula: dn=0; r=max(dn_i where dn_i=(C_i<C_{i-1})?nz(dn_{i-1})+1:0 for i in [0..D]) with dn0=1
signal_direction: Negative; long streak = momentum continuation down
rationale: Consecutive down closes indicate sustained selling; trend-following algos add shorts
limitation: Weak standalone; needs trend regime filter

name: shark_32_signal
formula: r=1 if exists i in [0..D-2] where L_{i+2}<L_{i+1}<L_i and H_{i+2}>H_{i+1}>H_i else 0
signal_direction: Binary; breakout of locked pattern high/low predicts direction
rationale: Three-bar expanding volatility pattern defines key support/resistance for breakout
limitation: Requires >=3 bars; false breaks in chop

name: volume_surge_max
input_data: OHLCV bars[0..D]; Index daily volume T-1
signal_direction: Positive; large surge = strong commitment; expect follow-through
rationale: Volume surge signals institutional participation; direction depends on price action

name: volume_dryup_ratio
formula: ev=sma_vol_daily[T-1]/48; r=sum(1 for i in [0..D] if V_i<ev)/(D+1)
input_data: OHLCV bars[0..D]; Index daily volume T-1
signal_direction: Negative; high dryup = low participation; range likely to persist
rationale: Low volume bars show lack of institutional interest; price drifts without direction

name: pullback_ratio
signal_direction: Negative; high pullback = fading opening strength
rationale: If opening high was aggressive, pullback shows rejection; lower afternoon return likely

name: rally_ratio
signal_direction: Positive; high rally = strong bid; expect continued upside
rationale: Opening low acted as support; buyers absorbed selling and pushed higher

name: range_expansion_ratio
signal_direction: Positive; large expansion = trending conviction; expect direction persistence
rationale: Bar-by-bar range expansion shows escalating commitment in one direction

name: volume_concentration
signal_direction: Negative; high concentration = one-sided burst then exhaustion
rationale: Front-loaded volume shows aggressive entry but limited follow-through capacity

name: close_vs_open_range
concept: Decision close vs first bar range
signal_direction: Positive = above first bar midpoint; Negative = below
rationale: Relative position encodes whether opening momentum carried through or faded
limitation: Wide first bar range reduces sensitivity

name: vwap_deviation_max
signal_direction: Negative; large deviation = likely revert to VWAP by close
rationale: VWAP acts as intraday magnet; large early deviation tends to mean-revert by 14:30
limitation: Requires volume data; unreliable illiquid sessions

name: net_volume_flow
signal_direction: Positive = net buying; Negative = net selling
rationale: Signed volume flow captures which side absorbed opening imbalance
limitation: Sign flips with bar close location

name: orb_breakout_sentiment
formula: hh=max(H_i i=[0..D]); ll=min(L_i i=[0..D]); r=sign(C_D-hh) if C_D>hh else sign(C_D-ll) if C_D<ll else 0
signal_direction: Contextual; sign indicates breakout direction (or range-bound)
rationale: Breakout of first-bar range confirms opening auction direction; trend persists
limitation: Narrow ranges produce whipsaws; combine with volume filter

name: consecutive_bullish_engulfing
formula: r=max(0,sum(1 for i in [1..D] where C_i>O_i and C_i>O_{i-1} and O_i<C_{i-1})) cap 3
signal_direction: Positive; multiple engulfing = strong absorption; expect continued upside
rationale: Each bullish engulfing = aggressive bid absorbing prior supply; stacked engulfs = powerful
limitation: Rare in strong downtrends; choppy markets produce many small engulfs

name: consecutive_bearish_engulfing
formula: r=max(0,sum(1 for i in [1..D] where C_i<O_i and C_i<O_{i-1} and O_i>C_{i-1})) cap 3
signal_direction: Negative; multiple bearish engulfing = strong supply absorption
rationale: Each bearish engulfing = aggressive offer absorbing prior demand; stacked engulfs = powerful downside
limitation: Rare in strong uptrends; choppy markets produce many small engulfs

name: early_body_momentum
signal_direction: Positive = net bullish bodies; Negative = net bearish bodies
rationale: Cumulative body direction measures commitment strength in opening session
limitation: Neutralized in wide range bars; combine with volume

name: vwap_slope_intraday
signal_direction: Positive slope = rising VWAP; bullish; Negative = falling VWAP; bearish
rationale: VWAP slope reflects where volume-weighted value is heading intraday

name: vwap_cross_count
formula: vwap_i as above; r=sum(1 for i in [0..D] where (C_i>vwap_i)!=(C_{i-1}>vwap_{i-1}))
signal_direction: Negative; high cross count = chop around VWAP; low conviction
rationale: Frequent VWAP crossings show no consensus; price oscillates around value
limitation: Requires volume; high in very volatile sessions

name: volume_percentile_rank
formula: ev_hist=sorted(V_{T-1} j=[1..20]); r=percentile_rank(V_i, ev_hist) for peak bar i=argmax(V)
input_data: OHLCV bars[0..D]; Index daily volume T-21..T-1
signal_direction: Positive; high percentile = institutional participation
rationale: Relative volume context distinguishes normal surge from exceptional commitment
limitation: Sparse history distorts percentile; need >=20 days

name: upper_shadow_rejection
signal_direction: Negative; long upper shadow = rejection of highs; fade
rationale: Upper shadow shows aggressive selling above body; limits accepted but rejected
limitation: Weak in strong uptrends where upper shadows are pullbacks

name: lower_shadow_rejection
signal_direction: Positive; long lower shadow = rejection of lows; bounce
rationale: Lower shadow shows aggressive buying below body; dip-bids absorb selling
limitation: Weak in strong downtrends where lower shadows are rallies

name: trend_bar_dominance
formula: tb=sum(1 for i in [0..D] if (C_i>O_i and (C_i-L_i)/(H_i-L_i+1e-8)>0.7) or (C_i<O_i and (H_i-C_i)/(H_i-L+1e-8)>0.7)); r=tb/(D+1)
signal_direction: Positive for bullish trend bars; Negative for bearish
rationale: Trend bars show one-sided conviction; dominance indicates direction persistence

name: open_efficiency
concept: How much of bar range filled from open
signal_direction: Positive = efficient trend bars; Negative = reversal bars
rationale: High efficiency = directional bars; low efficiency = indecision/reversal bars

name: late_bar_momentum
formula: r=sum((C_i-O_i)/(H_i-L_i+1e-8) for i in [D-1..D]) - sum((C_i-O_i)/(H_i-L_i+1e-8) for i in [0..1])
signal_direction: Positive = accelerating bullish; Negative = accelerating bearish
rationale: Momentum shift into decision bar shows where conviction is building at decision time

name: volume_price_corr
signal_direction: Positive = volume confirms direction; Negative = volume divergence
rationale: High correlation = institutional participation aligned with price; divergence = exhaustion
limitation: Unstable with few bars; needs >=5 bars

name: range_expansion_final_bar
signal_direction: Positive = expanding into decision; Negative = contracting
rationale: Decision bar range expansion shows escalation; contraction shows resolution

name: consecutive_lower_lows
formula: ll=0; r=max(ll_i where ll_i=(L_i<L_{i-1})?nz(ll_{i-1})+1:0 for i in [0..D]) with ll0=1
signal_direction: Negative; long streak = bearish momentum
rationale: Consecutive lower lows = sustained aggressive selling; trend-following shorts add

name: consecutive_higher_highs
formula: hh=0; r=max(hh_i where hh_i=(H_i>H_{i-1})?nz(hh_{i-1})+1:0 for i in [0..D]) with hh0=1
signal_direction: Positive; long streak = bullish momentum
rationale: Consecutive higher highs = sustained aggressive buying; trend-following longs add

name: vwap_deviation_decision_bar
signal_direction: Positive = close above VWAP; Negative = below
rationale: Decision bar position relative to VWAP captures final-minute institutional positioning

name: volume_per_bar_regime
concept: Sum volume vs expected daily fraction
input_data: OHLCV bars[0..D]; Index daily volume T-1
signal_direction: Positive = above-average volume in opening bars
rationale: Above-expected volume in opening bars signals institutional commitment early

name: decision_bar_reversal_signal
concept: Decision bar reversal from prior bar
formula: r=sign(C_D-O_D)*(1 if ((C_D>O_D and L_D<L_{D-1}) or (C_D<O_D and H_D>H_{D-1})) else 0)
signal_direction: Positive = bullish reversal at decision; Negative = bearish reversal
rationale: Reversal at decision bar shows last-minute conviction shift; predicts afternoon continuation
limitation: Weak if D very small; false in chop

name: opening_range_position
signal_direction: Positive near 1 = strong bullish; near 0 = strong bearish
rationale: Position within opening range at decision encodes auction outcome conviction
limitation: Narrow ranges meaningless; combine with volume

name: first_bar_body_ratio
concept: First bar body relative to range
signal_direction: Positive = strong directional first bar; 0 = doji
rationale: Large first bar body shows strong overnight conviction; doji = uncertainty

name: consecutive_same_close_dir
formula: up=0; dn=0; r=max(max(up_i where up_i=(C_i>C_{i-1})?nz(up_{i-1})+1:0), max(dn_i where dn_i=(C_i<C_{i-1})?nz(dn_{i-1})+1:0))
signal_direction: Positive for up streak; Negative for down streak
rationale: Long streaks show sustained directional momentum; trend-following algorithms participate

name: volume_trend_intraday
signal_direction: Positive = rising volume; Negative = falling volume
rationale: Rising volume in opening bars = growing participation; falling = fading interest

name: pullback_depth_ratio
concept: Depth of pullback from opening high
signal_direction: Negative; deep pullback = rejection of opening high
rationale: Deep pullback shows selling absorption after opening high; fades afternoon

name: range_compression_ratio
concept: Opening bar range vs recent ATR
signal_direction: Positive; wide range = high vol regime
rationale: Normalizing opening range by recent ATR puts volatility in context

name: close_above_open_count
concept: Count of bars closing above open
formula: r=sum(1 for i in [0..D] if C_i>O_i)
signal_direction: Positive; ratio above 0.5 = bullish bias
rationale: Ratio of up-close bars measures buying pressure throughout opening session

name: high_low_sequence_momentum
formula: r=(sum(C_i-O_i for i in [0..D]))/(sum(abs(C_i-O_i)+1e-8 for i in [0..D]))
signal_direction: Continuous [-1,+1] = net momentum direction
rationale: Net signed momentum relative to absolute action measures conviction direction

name: intraday_slope
signal_direction: Positive slope = rising closes; Negative = falling closes
rationale: Slope captures trend direction and strength of intraday price trajectory
normalization: Divide by mean price for % scale

name: opening_momentum_score
signal_direction: Continuous [-1,+1]
rationale: Combines direction and strength of each bar into single opening conviction score

name: decision_bar_body
signal_direction: Positive = strong directional close at decision
rationale: Large body at decision shows clear last-minute positioning; small body = uncertainty

name: volume_weighted_price_position
formula: vwap_D=cumsum(C_j*V_j j=0..D)/cumsum(V_j j=0..D); r=(vwap_D-ll)/(hh-ll+1e-8) where hh=max(H_i) ll=min(L_i)
signal_direction: Contextual; above midpoint = bullish value area
rationale: Volume-weighted value location relative to opening range shows institutional anchor

name: trend_exhaustion_early
signal_direction: Negative; high = strong trend intact; low = exhaustion
rationale: When high momentum does not produce long streaks, trend is weak/exhausting

name: consolidation_bars_count
concept: Count of inside bars in opening
formula: r=sum(1 for i in [1..D] where H_i<=H_{i-1} and L_i>=L_{i-1})
signal_direction: Zero count = trending; high count = consolidation
rationale: More inside bars = tighter coiling; predicts larger eventual breakout direction

name: breakout_strength_ratio
formula: hh=max(H_i i=[0..D]); ll=min(L_i i=[0..D]); r=(C_D-hh)/(hh-ll+1e-8) if C_D>hh else (C_D-ll)/(hh-ll+1e-8) if C_D<ll else 0
signal_direction: Continuous; positive = upside breakout strength; negative = downside
rationale: Strength of breakout beyond opening range predicts momentum persistence

name: momentum_divergence
formula: price_mom=intraday_slope; vol_mom=volume_trend_intraday; r=sign(price_mom)*sign(-vol_mom) if abs(vol_mom)>threshold else 0
signal_direction: Negative = divergence (bad); Positive = confirmation
rationale: Price moving without volume support = divergence = likely reversal/fade

name: session_high_proximity
signal_direction: Positive near 1 = near session high
rationale: Closing near high shows strong bid absorption; supports upside continuation
limitation: Weak if D small or range narrow

name: session_low_proximity
signal_direction: Negative near 0 = near session low
rationale: Closing near low shows strong offer absorption; supports downside continuation
limitation: Weak if D small or range narrow

name: opening_direction_stability
signal_direction: High = stable direction; Low = flipping
rationale: Stable direction in opening bars = clear market bias; unstable = indecision

name: vwap_reversion_strength
signal_direction: Negative = reverted; Positive = extended from VWAP
rationale: Distance from VWAP in ATR units; large deviation tends to revert toward close

name: momentum_strength_intraday
signal_direction: Positive = bullish momentum; Negative = bearish
rationale: Momentum normalized by ATR captures strength independent of volatility regime

name: volatility_regime_intraday
signal_direction: Positive = elevated vol; Negative = suppressed vol
rationale: Relative vol conditions how much conviction/participation to expect

name: trend_strength_intraday
signal_direction: Continuous [-1,+1]
rationale: More bars same direction = stronger trend; high positive = consistent buying

name: price_position_range
concept: Close position in current day's range
signal_direction: Contextual; near 1 = near high; near 0 = near low
rationale: Position in range at decision time encodes where value/bids/offers stand

name: open_to_current_return
concept: Return from open to decision close
signal_direction: Continuous; positive = above open; negative = below
rationale: Captures cumulative drift from opening price; simple but powerful

name: bar_size_trend
signal_direction: Positive = expanding bars; Negative = contracting
rationale: Expanding bars show escalating volatility; contracting = resolution/coiling

name: body_size_trend
signal_direction: Positive = growing bodies; Negative = shrinking bodies
rationale: Growing bodies = stronger directional commitment; shrinking = indecision widening

name: volume_acceleration
signal_direction: Positive = volume accelerating toward decision
rationale: Rising volume into decision = building institutional commitment late

name: pullback_depth_max
signal_direction: Negative; deep pullback = strong rejection
rationale: Deep pullback from opening high shows aggressive selling absorption

name: rally_strength_max
signal_direction: Positive; strong rally = aggressive buying
rationale: Strong rally from opening low shows aggressive demand absorption

name: intraday_autocorr
signal_direction: Positive = trend persistence; Negative = mean-reversion
rationale: Positive autocorr = trending; negative = choppy/mean-reverting regime

name: trend_adherence
concept: Fraction bars following bar n-1 direction
formula: r=sum(1 for i in [1..D] if sign(C_i-O_i)==sign(C_{i-1}-O_{i-1}))/(D)
signal_direction: High = trend persistence; Low = choppy
rationale: Higher adherence = clearer trend; low adherence = whipsaw regime

name: upper_wick_dominance
concept: Max upper wick / max lower wick
signal_direction: High = rejection of highs; Low = rejection of lows
rationale: Relative tail dominance shows which side is rejecting prices more aggressively
limitation: Zero division when no lower wicks

name: early_trend_hhi
formula: signs=[sign(C_i-O_i) for i in [0..D]]; r=sum((count(s)/len(signs))^2 for s in {+1,-1})
signal_direction: High (near 1) = all bars same direction; Low (0.5) = mixed
rationale: Concentration of direction measures regime clarity; HHI near 1 = strong trend

name: decision_bar_range_rank
concept: Decision bar range rank in opening
signal_direction: High = decision bar has largest range
rationale: Largest range at decision = escalation; smallest = resolution

name: consecutive_down_closes_strength
formula: dn=0; r=max(dn_i where dn_i=(C_i<C_{i-1})?nz(dn_{i-1})+1:0 for i in [0..D])/(D+1) with dn0=1
signal_direction: Negative; long streak = momentum continuation
rationale: Normalized by length to compare strength across different D

name: consecutive_up_closes_strength
formula: up=0; r=max(up_i where up_i=(C_i>C_{i-1})?nz(up_{i-1})+1:0 for i in [0..D])/(D+1) with up0=1
signal_direction: Positive; long streak = momentum continuation
rationale: Normalized by length to compare strength across different D

name: volume_regime_shift
concept: Volume vs prior day same bar
input_data: OHLCV bars[0..D]; Index recent same-bar volume
signal_direction: Positive = above-normal volume regime
rationale: Comparing to prior N days same opening-bar volume detects regime change

name: rsi_opening
formula: up=mean(max(C_i-O_i,0) for i in [0..D]); dn=mean(max(O_i-C_i,0) for i in [0..D]); r=100-100/(1+up/(dn+1e-8))
signal_direction: Contextual; >70 overbought; <30 oversold
rationale: RSI captures momentum exhaustion in opening session; extreme values predict fade

name: stoch_opening
signal_direction: Contextual; >80 overbought; <20 oversold
rationale: Stochastic measures close position in opening range; extreme = exhaustion

name: adx_opening
formula: up_move=max(H_i-L_{i-1},0); dn_move=max(L_{i-1}-H_i,0); atr=mean(max(H_i-L_i,max(abs(H_i-C_i),abs(L_i-C_i))) for i); +dm=mean(up_move); -dm=mean(dn_move); dx=100*abs(+dm-(-dm))/(+dm+(-dm)+1e-8); r=mean(dx)
signal_direction: Continuous [0,100]; high = strong trend
rationale: ADX measures whether opening session is trending or ranging; >25 = trend
normalization: Already [0,100]; min-max to [0,1],Needs >=14 bars; D usually small"

name: yesterday_range_ratio
signal_direction: Positive; wide range = high vol event
rationale: Yesterday range reflects prior session uncertainty; wide range = volatile regime

name: yesterday_body_ratio
signal_direction: Contextual; close to 1 = strong directional day
rationale: Strong body yesterday = strong conviction; doji = indecision carries over

name: yesterday_volume_ratio
signal_direction: Positive = above-average volume day
rationale: Above-average volume yesterday = institutional activity; may affect today's open

name: yesterday_return
signal_direction: Continuous; positive = up day; negative = down day
rationale: Prior day return sets baseline expectation; mean-reversion or continuation effects

name: yesterday_gap
signal_direction: Continuous; positive = gap up; negative = gap down
rationale: Yesterday gap indicates overnight sentiment; large gaps often partially fill today

name: yesterday_close_position
signal_direction: Contextual; near 1 = closed at high; near 0 = closed at low
rationale: Closing near high/low indicates end-of-day conviction; affects overnight positioning

name: sma_distance_5d
signal_direction: Positive = above SMA; Negative = below
rationale: Price relative to short-term SMA indicates short-term trend direction

name: sma_distance_20d
signal_direction: Positive = above SMA; Negative = below
rationale: Medium-term trend context; >20d SMA = bull regime; below = bear

name: sma_distance_60d
signal_direction: Positive = above SMA; Negative = below
rationale: Long-term trend filter; avoids counter-trend entries in strong trends

name: volatility_percentile_20d
signal_direction: Continuous [0,1]; high = elevated vol
rationale: Relative vol context conditions how much conviction to expect in opening bars

name: volume_percentile_20d
signal_direction: Continuous [0,1]; high = high participation
rationale: Relative volume context distinguishes normal from exceptional participation

name: yesterday_intraday_close_position
concept: Yesterday decision bar close in range
signal_direction: Contextual; near 1 = bullish carry-over; near 0 = bearish
rationale: Yesterday's closing position in its opening range predicts overnight positioning

name: yesterday_gap_reversal
formula: let p=T-2 close; g=(O0_{T-1}-p)/p; u=max(0,O0-min(L0,L1)_{T-1})/(g*p+1e-8) if g>0.002 else 0; d=max(0,max(H0,H1)_{T-1}-O0)/(-g*p+1e-8) if g<-0.002 else 0; r=u-d
input_data: OHLC bars[0..D] for T-1; prior close
signal_direction: Continuous [-1,1]; mirrors opening_gap_reversal but for yesterday
rationale: Yesterday gap reversal captured how prior day absorbed overnight imbalance

name: yesterday_spike_exhaustion
signal_direction: Positive = exhausted spike yesterday; Negative = strong channel
rationale: Yesterday's exhaustion/follow-through condition sets up today's regime

name: yearly_high_distance
signal_direction: Negative = near high; more negative = closer
rationale: Proximity to yearly high affects profit-taking behavior and trend strength

name: yearly_low_distance
signal_direction: Positive = far from low; negative = near low
rationale: Proximity to yearly low affects dip-buying and support strength

name: vwap_touch_count
formula: vwap_i=cumsum(C_j*V_j j=0..i)/cumsum(V_j j=0..i); r=sum(1 for i in [0..D] if min(L_i,C_i)<=vwap_i and max(H_i,C_i)>=vwap_i)
signal_direction: High = mean-reversion around VWAP; Low = trending away
rationale: Frequent VWAP touches show price gravitating to value; predicts range expansion/reversion

name: early_bullish_engulfing_count
formula: r=sum(1 for i in [1..D] where C_i>O_i and C_i>O_{i-1} and O_i<C_{i-1} and C_{i-1}<O_{i-1})
signal_direction: Positive; count indicates absorption strength
rationale: Bullish engulfing = aggressive bid absorbing prior supply; stacked = strong

name: early_bearish_engulfing_count
formula: r=sum(1 for i in [1..D] where C_i<O_i and C_i<O_{i-1} and O_i>C_{i-1} and C_{i-1}>O_{i-1})
signal_direction: Negative; count indicates absorption strength
rationale: Bearish engulfing = aggressive offer absorbing prior demand; stacked = strong downside

name: gap_fill_ratio
formula: r=sum(1 for i in [2..D] where gap_exists and fill_occurred)/(count gaps + 1e-8)
signal_direction: Negative; high fill ratio = mean-revert regime
rationale: Markets with frequent gap fills reward fade strategies over breakout strategies

name: close_to_high_ratio
signal_direction: Near 1 = closed near high = bullish
rationale: Close near high shows buyers won last-minute auction; predicts continued upside

name: close_to_low_ratio
signal_direction: Near 0 = closed near low = bearish
rationale: Close near low shows sellers won last-minute auction; predicts continued downside

name: opening_auction_imbalance
signal_direction: Continuous [-1,+1]; positive = net buying
rationale: Volume-weighted imbalance captures which side dominated opening auction

name: early_trend_consistency
formula: signs=[sign(C_i-C_{i-1}) for i in [1..D]]; positive=sum(1 for s in signs if s>0); negative=sum(1 for s in signs if s<0); r=max(positive,negative)/len(signs)
signal_direction: Continuous [0,1]; high = consistent trend
rationale: Consistent return direction shows trend; mixed shows chop/range

name: volume_surge_direction
input_data: OHLCV bars[0..D]; Index daily volume T-1
signal_direction: Positive = bullish surge; Negative = bearish surge
rationale: Volume surge aligned with price direction shows institutional commitment
